correction: v2 marks the 2025-12-31 entry decision unknown at the WITHOUT2026 cutoff; its P1_D1 state is only observed on 2026-01-06. No return, rule, or confusion result changes. Initial output retained.

method.universe: All 147 actual original highH3 entries: 146 CLOSED plus one terminal OPEN; no restriction to H6 common entries.
method.state: At E+2 close, P=normalized close/(actual entry price*1.001)-1>0; D=close/prior tradable close-1>0. Exact zero thresholds fixed, no search; decision known after close.
method.label: Same actual quantity sold at E+3 vs E+6 using public resolve_fill, blocked exits retried on later tradable sessions; both charge 0.001 sell fees. Existing buy outlay includes actual buy fee.
method.scope: Annual cohorts use actual entry year, not annual account profit. WITHOUT2026 truncates observation at 2025-12-31 and explicitly censors labels not yet observable.
method.pnl_comparison: Actual H3 exit profitability is future information relative to E+2; used solely for mismatch diagnostics.
method.fixed_rules: P,D,P_AND_D,P_OR_D paired labels share original H3 entries. Unselected increment is zero; this is not a continuous account because extension can change later entry opportunities.
method.trimming: Delete highest 3/5 individual increments or returns and recompute arithmetic mean; no executable counterfactual.
method.precision: 1e-12 tolerance only normalizes reported near-zero labels; P and D classifiers retain the specified strict >0.
method.censoring: No invented post-window prices or terminal sell fees. The terminal OPEN lacks E+2 state and future exit labels.

price_scale_audit.raw_limits_and_tick: Each execution date raw limits and 0.01 raw tick multiplied by contemporaneous normalized HFQ/raw close ratio.
